## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fó shuō fàng-niú jīng* is a single-fascicle Yáo-Qín 後秦 translation by Kumārajīva of the *Mahāgopālaka-sūtra*, the discourse comparing the eleven qualities of a good cowherd with the eleven qualities of a good monk. The Pāli parallel is MN 33 *Mahāgopālaka-sutta*; the Chinese parallels are T99[1248] (*Saṃyukta-āgama*), [T124](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0124) (Xuánzàng), and *Ekottara-āgama* 49.1 (T125).

**Abstract**

T123 was produced during Kumārajīva's Cháng'ān period (401–413 CE), recorded in the frontmatter. Like [T35](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0035), T123 is one of the relatively few Āgama-extracts in Kumārajīva's principally Mahāyāna corpus. The Indic source is presumed lost.
